## Pentair Completes Acquisition of Taco Group Holdings


October 1, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.pentair.com/node/27181/pdf)


*Accelerates the Company’s Growth Strategy and Expands Portfolio of Smart, Sustainable Water Solutions Aligned with Secular Mega Trends*


LONDON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 1, 2026--


Pentair plc (NYSE: PNR), a leader in helping the world sustainably move, improve, and enjoy water, life’s most essential resource, today announced that it has successfully completed its acquisition of Taco Group Holdings (Taco), a leader in hydronic and water-based solutions, for $1.4 billion, subject to customary adjustments.


The transaction is expected to accelerate Pentair’s growth strategy and expand the Company’s portfolio of smart, sustainable water solutions aligned to secular water trends. Bringing together Pentair’s and Taco’s complementary portfolios, channels and go-to-market strategies will enable the combined company to broaden customer access and deepen partnerships, creating cross-selling opportunities and new revenue streams.


“We are excited to welcome the Taco team to Pentair as we enter into a new chapter of growth as a stronger company focused on delivering innovative water solutions,” said John L. Stauch, Pentair President and CEO. “Adding Taco provides us with a comprehensive suite of premier solutions and scales our position in high-growth commercial and mission-critical end-markets. We are confident that together, we will create an attractive growth engine and unlock profitability as we scale Taco’s business and advance the development of innovative offerings to support customers around the world.”


“Today’s acquisition closing marks an exciting new chapter in the evolution of Taco,” said John Hazen White Jr., Chief Executive Officer and Owner, Taco LLC. “It will further strengthen our ability to support our employees, customers and communities, while creating opportunities for continued growth.”


Benjamin White, President, Taco LLC added, “This is a great day as we celebrate this important milestone in Taco’s history. I am pleased that Pentair chose Taco and recognized the same value in our company that our customers and team experience every day.”


As previously announced, Taco will be part of Pentair’s Water Solutions reporting segment and will continue to go to market under the Taco brand. Taco will maintain a significant presence in Cranston, Rhode Island.


**About Pentair plc**


At Pentair, we help the world sustainably move, improve, and enjoy water, life’s most essential resource. From our residential and commercial water solutions, to industrial water management and everything in between, Pentair is a core large cap value S&P 500 equity stock focused on smart, sustainable water solutions that help our planet and people thrive.


Pentair had revenue in 2025 of approximately $4.2 billion, and trades under the ticker symbol PNR. With approximately 9,000 global employees serving customers in more than 150 countries, we work to help improve lives and the environment around the world.
